name: mcp-atlassian
description: Jira and Confluence tools over MCP, with a Markdown/ADF converter that round-trips: panels, quotes, expands, tables and status lozenges survive a read, edit and write back.

jira_url.title: Jira base URL
jira_url.description: e.g. https://your-company.atlassian.net — leave empty to disable Jira tools.

jira_username.title: Jira account email
jira_username.description: The email of the account the API token belongs to. Cloud only; leave empty when using a Server/DC personal access token.

jira_api_token.title: Jira API token
jira_api_token.description: Create one at id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. On Server/DC, use a personal access token instead.

confluence_url.title: Confluence base URL
confluence_url.description: e.g. https://your-company.atlassian.net/wiki — leave empty to disable Confluence tools.

confluence_username.title: Confluence account email
confluence_username.description: Usually the same as the Jira account email.

confluence_api_token.title: Confluence API token
confluence_api_token.description: The same token as Jira works on Atlassian Cloud.

server_source.title: Run from this checkout instead
server_source.description: Optional. Point this at a clone of the repository to run that working tree rather than the copy shipped with the plugin — the dev loop. Equivalent to setting MCP_ATLASSIAN_SRC.
